name: Takenaka Hanbei
source:
A genius strategist who is a matchless pair with Kanbei. A handsome young man who has a feeling of transparency about him.
He serves Hashiba's army and he's building a relationship of deep mutual trust with his master Hideyoshi.

[Spoiler]He used to be known as Kageroumaru when he lived 
in the village of Iga[/Spoiler]
